content.query:
-- Create Masterkey
CREATE MASTER KEY ENCRYPTION BY PASSWORD = ''

-- Database Scoped Credential
CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL noor_creds
WITH IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity'

-- External Data Source

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE silver_source
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'https://projectstoragenoor.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/',
    CREDENTIAL = noor_creds
)

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE gold_source
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'https://projectstoragenoor.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/',
    CREDENTIAL = noor_creds
)

-- External file format
CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT parquet_format
WITH
(
    FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET,
    DATA_COMPRESSION = 'org.apache.hadoop.io.compress.SnappyCodec'

)

CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT delta_format
WITH
(
    FORMAT_TYPE = DELTA,
    DATA_COMPRESSION = 'org.apache.hadoop.io.compress.SnappyCodec'

)
